info.title: AKAC Reference Admin and SCIM API
info.description: Operator-facing API on its own listener (default port 8788). Credentials are administrator identities bound to a tenant and an admin actor; agent credentials are rejected and admin credentials are rejected on the agent listener. Authority is the admin actor's standing role (security-admin, kb-admin, auditor), enforced and audited on every call. The tenant always comes from the credential. Exactly one authentication mode is configured: opaque tokens (SHA-256 digested) or verified at+jwt with an audience distinct from the agent API. Limits are per process. Every failure that reached the control plane carries the audited `decisionId`. A valid W3C `traceparent` request header is recorded (its trace id only) with the audited decision.

Only documents: memory and artifacts are revoked with POST /admin/v1/revocations (security-admin).

post.summary: Issue a root or attenuated run grant
post.description: Requires security-admin. `Idempotency-Key` replays the stored response for an identical body; a different body under the same key is 422. The store is an in-memory LRU per administrator and per instance. A replay is re-authorized (403 if the administrator no longer holds security-admin) and audited as IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY; key reuse is audited as a denial.

get.summary: Current tree head and, when a checkpoint key is configured, its format 2 signature
get.description: Requires auditor. Returns the RFC 9162 tree head of the tenant audit stream (including this read's own audit entry). The checkpoint is signed by a server-held Ed25519 key (AKAC_CHECKPOINT_KEY_FILE) and attests only what this server saw; anchor checkpoints signed with an offline key (scripts/checkpoint.ts) for independent evidence. No query parameters.

post.summary: Erase a record (GDPR Art. 17) and, by default, its lineage
post.description: Requires security-admin. Tombstones the record and, with cascade (default true), every record derived from it. A legal hold on the record or any descendant is 409 with `held` and nothing is erased; without cascade a live descendant is 409. Audit entries are kept, content-free. Idempotent; advances the tenant epoch.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque administrator token (at least 32 characters) or an at+jwt for the admin audience.

dpopAuth.description: Optional sender-constrained access token (RFC 9449). Send `Authorization: DPoP <access token>` and a `DPoP` proof header (compact JWS, typ dpop+jwt, ES256, EdDSA or PS256, public jwk in the header, htm, htu without query, iat, unique jti, ath = base64url SHA-256 of the access token). The access token must carry cnf.jkt equal to the RFC 7638 thumbprint of the proof key. Enabled per listener with AKAC_DPOP or AKAC_ADMIN_DPOP (off, optional, required); when required, Bearer is refused, and a token with cnf.jkt is never accepted as Bearer. Server nonces (DPoP-Nonce) are not supported. A refusal is 401 with a WWW-Authenticate DPoP challenge (error invalid_dpop_proof or invalid_token).

XRequestId.description: Server-generated request id, also present in logs. A client-supplied value is ignored.

holders.description: SOD_VIOLATION from a role or constraint change only: how many currently valid principals the change would invalidate. Identities are never returned.

decisionId.description: UUIDv4 of the audited control-plane decision, when the attempt reached one.

held.description: CONFLICT from erase only: how many records of the lineage are under legal hold. Identities are never returned.

origin.description: Model-origin content enters only through derive().

retainUntil.description: Epoch milliseconds. From this time the retention job (POST /admin/v1/retention/apply) erases the record unless it is under legal hold.

AuditEntry.description: One entry of a tenant audit stream. Format 1 (no formatVersion): hash = SHA-256 of sorted-key JSON of the other members. Format 2: hash = SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) form of the other members. Both: previous = hash of the preceding entry of the stream (GENESIS = 64 zeros); RFC 9162 leaf = SHA-256(0x00 || JCS(entry)).

runtimeRevision.description: Runtime policy revision applied by a trusted runtime enforcer (0.5); never from an agent over HTTP

ScimExtension.description: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:akac:2.0:User. clearance and projects apply to users; roles to groups.

ScimUserRequest.description: Profile attributes beyond those listed are accepted and discarded; roles, groups and entitlements are rejected.

Obligation.description: Closed AKAC 0.4 obligation set (draft-aligned with the AuthZEN obligations working-group draft; not a conformance claim). A PEP that cannot enforce every obligation of an allow MUST treat it as a deny.

oneOf.description: 0.5 (ADR-012): the runtime holding the content MUST apply this operator-reviewed profile for the domain. At most one profile per domain; different profiles for one domain are unsatisfiable (deny).
0.5 (ADR-012): every output derived from the content MUST carry at least this classification outside AKAC (the transitive classification of the decision).

Checkpoint.description: Signed audit checkpoint. Format 2 signs the JCS form of {format, stream, treeSize, rootHash, issuedAt, keyId} with Ed25519; rootHash is the RFC 9162 root of the first treeSize entries. Format 1 (0.2-0.3) remains verifiable.

InclusionProof.description: RFC 9162 §2.1.3 inclusion proof; leafIndex = sequence - 1. Verify against a trusted checkpoint.

ConsistencyProof.description: RFC 9162 §2.1.4 consistency proof between two sizes of one tenant stream.

checkpoint.description: Format 2, present when the server is configured with a checkpoint key.

DecisionId.description: UUIDv4 of the audited decision; the audit entry carries the same id.

LineageRecord.description: Metadata only: no content and no ACL.

DestinationBody.description: The id must not equal a destination class name.

RuntimeProfileBody.description: Runtime profile policy (0.5, ADR-012). Applies to decisions whose transitive classification is at least `classification` and, with `destinationClass`, only towards that destination class. Profile ids name operator-reviewed runtime templates; never runtime policy text.
